description: This Python source file provides utility functions to extract text from various file formats including TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It includes functions to process raw bytes, heuristics for detecting headers in spreadsheets, and generates structured summaries, JSON samples, and previews for each supported format. The main public function is extract_text_from_bytes, which detects the file type based on filename extension and applies the appropriate extraction method.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts readable text from a file based on its filename extension (.txt, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx). Uses specific helpers for each format and returns the extracted text along with any errors.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decodes bytes as UTF-8, ignoring errors, to extract text from plain text files.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses pdfminer.six to extract text content from a PDF document.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses python-docx to extract text from Word (.docx) files, including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Uses openpyxl to extract structured text from Excel (.xlsx) files, identifying headers, processing data rows, generating JSON samples and TSV previews, with safeguards for large files.

methods.name: Any _coerce_cell_value(val: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes cell values to be JSON serializable, handling numbers, bools, None, and converting other types to strings.

methods.name: bool _is_potential_header(row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a row in a spreadsheet looks like a header: at least two non-empty cells, not predominantly numeric.

methods.name: List[str] _sanitize_headers(raw_headers: List[Any])
methods.description: Ensures header names are non-empty, unique, and cleaned of whitespace or invalid characters.

methods.name: _extract_xlsx
methods.description: Main logic to process XLSX files, detect headers, parse sheets into structured data, generate JSON samples, TSV previews, and handle large files with configurable limits.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_record(headers: List[str], row_vals: List[Any])
methods.description: Maps a list of cell values to a dictionary keyed by headers with coerced values.

methods.name: str _record_to_tsv(headers: List[str], record: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a record dictionary into a TSV line respecting header order, sanitizing values.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Produces a short, collapsed preview string of the extracted text content for UI display.
